oneLine: Pragyawan Technologies files DRHP with SEBI for an upcoming IPO.

sources.title: Pragyawan Technologies Files DRHP With SEBI

synopsis: Pragyawan Technologies Limited has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Board of India to raise funds through an initial public offering. The public offer includes a fresh issue aggregating up to Rs 400 crore and an offer for sale of up to 15,000,000 equity shares with a face value of Rs 2 each. The net proceeds are intended to fund working capital requirements and general corporate purposes. Pantomath Capital Advisors Limited acts as the sole book running lead manager to the issue.
